local_checks.invariant: Chunk length must be checked against remaining file bytes before IHDR/IDAT are trusted; a short declared body must not be indexed as if it were the declared length.
local_checks.result: read_png_rgb unpacks length as >I and slices data[pos+8:pos+8+length] (compare-pages.py:43-47). Python slicing is bounds-safe, so a length larger than the remainder yields a short chunk rather than a native OOB read. IHDR then does struct.unpack('>IIBB', chunk[:10]) (line 49) with no check that the chunk is 13 bytes or even 10 bytes; a short IHDR raises uncaught struct.error, not PngError.

local_checks.invariant: Decompressed IDAT length must be validated against IHDR width/height/channels before any raw[i] or row[o] index.
local_checks.result: After zlib.decompress (line 62) there is no check that len(raw) == height * (1 + width * channels). filter_type = raw[i] (line 69) IndexErrors when a row filter byte is missing. filt = raw[i:i+stride] (line 71) silently short-slices; recon is a zeroed bytearray(stride) (line 73) so a short row is zero-padded and later row[o:o+2] (lines 95-97) stays in-bounds. That is defined wrong output, not an OOB. compare_images catches only PngError (lines 141-146), so IndexError/struct.error/zlib.error abort the process.

local_checks.invariant: Attacker-controlled width/height/length arithmetic must not wrap or truncate before it is used as an index or allocation size.
local_checks.result: width/height/length are unsigned 32-bit via struct (lines 44, 49). stride = width * channels, pos += 12 + length, and total = bw * bh use Python ints with no wrap. Reconstruction indexes (recon[x-channels], prev[x], row[o+2]) stay within stride when the height loop completes. No integer-wrap OOB path exists in this interpreter.

local_checks.invariant: A bounds miss must not promote live or corrupt another principal's memory; lower-trust PNG authors must be able to reach a native invalid read/write.
local_checks.result: Guard-path PNGs are written by Playwright page.screenshot (capture-pages.mjs:111-112), not by staging HTML. Crafted short/interlaced/CRC-invalid PNGs require write access to --before/--after or operator-chosen folders. A decode crash happens before --out is written (compare-pages.py:227-231); cmd_compare fail-closes when compare.json is absent (guard.py:405-407) and does not set pass_promote. CPython IndexError/struct.error is safe process termination, not memory corruption. No promote-integrity or native-OOB path survives the gates.

hardening: read_png_rgb should reject IHDR width/height above a screenshot-scale cap, require IHDR length 13, verify len(raw) == height * (1 + width * channels) before indexing, pass max_length to zlib.decompress, and wrap struct.error/zlib.error/IndexError/MemoryError as PngError so compare_images records a page fail instead of aborting.

compare_dirs should cap file size and page count before decode; cmd_compare already fail-closes when compare.json is missing, so these caps protect the operator VM rather than the promote integrity gate.

IHDR compression/filter/interlace bytes are ignored (only the first 10 IHDR bytes are unpacked). Interlaced or non-zero compression method PNGs would be reconstructed as sequential RGB; Playwright-written files are the expected input, but an explicit reject is the smallest parser hardening.

local_checks.invariant: A fatal after-snapshot must persist a rollbackable phase or invoke restore; it must not leave screenshot_after as the last saved state
local_checks.result: cmd_snapshot(when=after) does not change phase until capture_pages returns. capture_pages raises GuardError when the Node exit is not 0 or 1, or when capture.json is missing and stdout is not JSON. loadPlaywright process.exit(2) is fatal. An uncaught page.screenshot({fullPage:true}) throw hits main().catch, exits 1 without writing capture.json, and becomes GuardError('screenshot capture did not return JSON'). main() saves state.json only after a successful command, so the last persisted phase remains screenshot_after.

local_checks.invariant: cmd_run must reach restore after an after-capture fatal; a later command must not be the only recovery path
local_checks.result: From screenshot_after, cmd_run only retries snapshot after. It never calls cmd_rollback unless phase is already fail_rollback. cmd_compare does accept screenshot_after; missing after PNGs fail compare_images and a non-empty before set yields pass=false, which would persist fail_rollback. That compare-then-rollback sequence is a same-operator escape hatch. run, rollback, and the 'do not skip steps' runbook do not take it.

local_checks.invariant: A cmd_run that already applied staging updates must persist inventory so a later rollback can restore the pre-update set
local_checks.result: cmd_run chains snapshot-before, update-staging, and snapshot-after in one process. SSH updates run before after-capture. GuardError from the after-capture skips save_json, so a run started from idle or done leaves the prior persisted phase and no new inventory while staging already has the new packages. restore_items then has nothing to install even if the phase gate were opened.
